1: // Simple asteroid dodge game targeting canvas#game
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const width = canvas.width;
7:   const height = canvas.height;
8: 
9:   // Ship definition (triangle at bottom centre)
10:   const ship = {
11:     x: width / 2,
12:     y: height - 30,
13:     size: 20,
14:     speed: 5,
15:     moveLeft: false,
16:     moveRight: false,
17:     draw() {
18:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
19:       ctx.beginPath();
20:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y);
21:       ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.size, this.y + this.size * 1.5);
22:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.size, this.y + this.size * 1.5);
23:       ctx.closePath();
24:       ctx.fill();
25:     }
26:   };
27: 
28:   const asteroids = [];
29:   let spawnTimer = 0;
30:   let lastTime = performance.now();
31:   let score = 0;
32:   let gameOver = false;
33: 
34:   const keyDown = e => {
35:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') ship.moveLeft = true;
36:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') ship.moveRight = true;
37:   };
38:   const keyUp = e => {

41:   };
42:   window.addEventListener('keydown', keyDown);
43:   window.addEventListener('keyup', keyUp);
44: 
45:   function spawnAsteroid() {
46:     const radius = Math.random() * 15 + 5;
47:     const x = Math.random() * (width - radius * 2) + radius;
48:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 2 + score * 0.01; // speed increases with score
49:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -radius, radius, speed });
50:   }
51: 
52:   function update(dt) {
53:     // Move ship
54:     if (ship.moveLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
55:     if (ship.moveRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
56:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.size, Math.min(width - ship.size, ship.x));
57: 
58:     // Spawn asteroids
59:     spawnTimer += dt;
60:     if (spawnTimer > 1000) { // every second
61:       spawnAsteroid();
62:       spawnTimer = 0;
63:     }

65:     // Update asteroids
66:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
67:       const a = asteroids[i];
68:       a.y += a.speed;
69:       // Remove off‑screen
70:       if (a.y - a.radius > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
71:     }
72: 
73:     // Collision detection
74:     for (const a of asteroids) {
75:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
76:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
77:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
78:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.size) {
79:         gameOver = true;
80:         break;
81:       }
82:     }
83: 
84:     if (!gameOver) score += dt / 1000; // seconds
85:   }
86:

90:     ship.draw();

94:       ctx.beginPath();

96:       ctx.fill();
97:     }
98:     // Score
99:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
